name: Nikaidou Shinku
source:
Likes: Classical music, dogs
Dislikes: Children
Favorite food: Black coffee, pancakes
Disliked food: Sweets

Formerly the translucent sorceress who gave Yuuma his special power.
She is now a normal human and Yuuma can no longer use his powers.
A calm, rational girl who rarely shows her emotions. 
She exudes an air of maturity in stark contrast to her youthful appearance.

When she's with Yuuma, she shows a lot of her smiles and emotions.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.favo-soft.jp/soft/product/Hikari/chracter.htm]Japanese official Irotoridori no Hikari website[/url] and referenced the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591380/Irotoridori_No_Sekai_HD__The_Colorful_World/]English official Irotoridori no Sekai Steam page[/url]]
